Md Ashiqur Rahman

Md Ashiqur Rahman /æʃɪk/ 🎧

I am a final-year Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Purdue University, advised by Professor Raymond A. Yeh, and a Bilsland Dissertation Fellow. I received my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET), where I worked with Professor Md. Shamsuzzoha Bayzid.

I am on the 2026–27 job market, available Spring 2027.

I design robust, physically grounded AI systems by building the structure of the real world (symmetry, physics, and embodiment) into modern foundation models.

Symmetry & Robustness: Geometric deep learning, Provably robust AI systems
Scientific Machine Learning: Neural operators, Physics foundation models, Multiphysics and weather surrogates
Multimodal & Embodied AI: Multimodal LLMs and agents, Efficient vision-language-action models (VLAs)

For feedback or simply to connect, please feel free to leave an anonymous message.

Updates

Nov 2026
I am on the 2026–27 job market, available Spring 2027.
Oct 2026
Our paper on neural implicit LiDAR mapping (NIEO) was accepted at WACV 2027!
Sep 2026
Released SkipVLA, which pairs VLAs with classical planning to cut task-completion time by 46% and energy by 52% on a physical robot arm.
Aug 2026
Our survey on neural operators and data-driven scientific ML was published in IEEE TPAMI.
Jun 2026
Presented 'Tunable Soft Equivariance' at CVPR 2026 and released soft-equivariant vision foundation models on Hugging Face.

Joined Eli Lilly as a research intern, working on automating drug manufacturing processes.
